panels.is: Scene 3, a field: four young people by grey plinths, seen side by side, turned three-quarter to screen right; each takes a weapon (goth: crossbow; lanky lad: katana; lad in red football shirt: two uzis; small anxious woman: a grenade the size of an ostrich egg)

Scene 3, same: the goth has the crossbow up on her shoulder, pleased; lanky lad stares unsure at the katana held out flat; red-shirt lad sprays the uzis grinning; the woman clutches the grenade, terrified
Scene 4a, Cabinet Room turned round: Andy Burnham (Prime Minister) furious, jabbing a pointing finger at the camera; Pat McFadden (bald, round dark glasses) calm beside him; fireplace behind
Scene 4b: Alan Milburn across the green table, calm and nonplussed, hands folded on a folder, talking
Scene 4c: Pat speaks, fingers steepled, eyes on Andy (never the camera)
Scene 4c: Andy has flung his arms up and now folds them, leaning back, sulky

Scene 6, a thick forest: the four walk right in single file, turned three-quarter; the camera travels with them (near ferns race past): goth with crossbow on her shoulder, red-shirt lad with uzis at his chest, lanky lad holding the katana up in front like a torch, woman hugging the grenade
Scene 6: a flamethrower's jet whips out of the bush ahead, over their heads; all four duck
Scene 6: the red-shirt lad sprays back wildly; goth swings the crossbow up; lanky lad holds the katana flat over his head; the woman curls round the grenade, eyes shut
Scene 6: two spiked morning stars on chains swing down out of the trees over their heads
Scene 7a: Andy explodes, up out of his lean, both fists down on the table; Pat calm
Scene 7c: Andy despairing and angry, both hands out, palms up
Scene 7d: Milburn's eyes slide to the side
Scene 7e: Andy frozen, mouth hanging open in outrage; Pat, eyes on Andy, small approving smile
